rules.subheadings: tracking-wide uppercase text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

primary.description: Electric Indigo - Use for primary actions, active states, and brand moments.

secondary.description: Emerald - Use for success, growth metrics, and 'safe' actions.

destructive.description: Rose - Use for errors, alerts, and 'danger' zones.

background.description: Slate 50 (Light) / Slate 950 (Dark) - Never pure white or black.

surface.description: White (Light) / Slate 900 (Dark) - For cards and panels.

spacing_layout.scale: Tailwind Scale (p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16)

grid_system.dashboard: Bento Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6
grid_system.landing: Tetris Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8
rules: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly in marketing pages.
Use col-span-2 or col-span-full for hero elements.

buttons.style: Sharp corners or full pill (no default rounded-md).

cards.style: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800), no shadow by default.

inputs.style: bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500

charts.style: Minimalist, thin lines, no grid lines unless necessary. Use palette colors.

glassmorphism.usage: Sticky headers, modal overlays, and 'Lecture Recording' active state.

landing_hero.alt: Students studying in a modern library
landing_hero.usage: Hero section background or main visual

universal_guidelines: Do not use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit'.
Do not use gradients for text.
Do not center align the app container.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 'Bento Grid' layout for dashboards. Use the specified color palette strictly. Ensure dark mode is fully supported and tested. Use the provided image URLs for the respective sections. Implement the 'Glassmorphism' effect for the lecture recording overlay.
